'''Gragra''' was a [[Swokes Swokes]] [[Gender|female]] [[gorgmonger]] that worked in the [[Mos Espa Market|marketplace]] of [[Mos Espa]]. She caught [[Jar Jar Binks]] when he tried to snatch a [[gorg]] from her stand without paying.<ref name="FC" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gragra was voiced by [[Toby Longworth]].<ref name="Longworth">{{WebCite|url=https://starwarsinterviews.com/prequel-trilogy/episode-i-the-phantom-menace/toby-longworth-lott-dod|text=Toby Longworth (Lott Dod)|author=[[Dennis Pellegrom]]|date=2017-06|work=[[Star Wars Interviews]]|archivedate=20230205201422|nolive=1}}</ref>
